title: Grateful Dead Live at Hilton Hotel on 1969-03-15
source: Source: SBD > Bear's cassette > ??? > Sony ESXHiFi/L-750 beta tape; Transfer: PCM (Sony SL-10) > Sony PCM-601ESD > Behringer Ultramatch Pro > Tascam DA-3000 (wav 16-bit/44.1k); Lineage: wav > iZotope RX6 Advanced > iZotope Ozone 5 Advanced > CD Wave > TLH > Flac 16; edited and mastered SIRMick February 2018

ai_review.summary: Early‑'69 show with solid sound but uneven playing—Garcia still mastering slide and Pigpen a bit off‑kilter.
ai_review.review: The recording is generally clean enough for listeners, though reviewers never specify the source. Musically the performance divides opinion: one fan calls it "absolutely incredible" while another notes tentative slide work by Garcia, incoherent Pigpen vocals, and a missing segment of “Eleven.” Overall it's an interesting snapshot of the Dead in 1969 but not consistently stellar.

ai_rating.rationale: Two detailed reviews give divergent scores (5 and 3). The positive review praises overall show quality, while the critical one points out several performance flaws. No recording issues are reported, so rating leans toward a solid but not exceptional listening experience.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers do not comment on soundboard or audience sources; no complaints suggest the audio is acceptable and clear enough for enjoyment.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set pacing; reviewers focus on individual song issues rather than overall flow.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia is still learning slide technique and sounds tentative.
